name: Counter-Strike 2 External Roster Freeze, First Half of 2027
scope: Author-selected and author-approved external Counter-Strike 2 team rosters for the initial 2027 competitive ecosystem. It is not applied to every real-world organization, and no external roster list has been supplied yet.
notEstablished: No external Counter-Strike 2 roster is established or invented by this directive.

May 24, 2027 is the earliest date on which the author may initiate external roster changes; it is not an automatic transfer date, and no transfer, retirement, promotion, benching, or contract expiration occurs automatically.
Roster freeze does not imply qualification: no team, including Kairos, is qualified for the PGL Copenhagen Major 2027 by this directive.
disclaimer: Kairos Universe fictional continuity directive. It does not modify any frozen real-world source snapshot.
